ops.title: hermes-docker-proxy docker.sock-relay fix: forbiddenDest alone was INCOMPLETE (2 parser-differential bypasses)
ops.body:
The socktainer docker.sock-relay host escape (task da1c63): socktainer transparently relays any container bind/mount whose destination resolves to EXACTLY `/var/run/docker.sock` to its raw unfiltered Docker API = full host escape (reads host sops key + vault token). The proxy (`pkgs/hermes-docker-proxy/policy.go`) must screen create-body Binds/Mounts destinations so socktainer never sees a body it parses as a docker.sock relay.

**The prototype's `forbiddenDest()`-only fix was INCOMPLETE** (the prototype memo/verdict claimed "relay is docker.sock-exact so the fix is complete" — WRONG). Three adversarial codex refuter passes found TWO more bypasses, both cross-language parser differentials between the proxy's Go bind-string parser and socktainer's Swift `bind.split(separator: ":", omittingEmptySubsequences: true)`:

1. **ASCII empty-segment differential**: old code used first/second-colon `strings.Index` split → `"<src>::/var/run/docker.sock"` gave dst="" (allowed), while socktainer's split-drop-empty gave target=/var/run/docker.sock (relay). FIX: `splitBindSpec` = `strings.Split(":")` dropping empty segments, src=parts[0], dst=parts[1] — matches socktainer exactly for pure ASCII.

2. **Unicode grapheme-cluster differential**: Go `strings.Split` splits on raw 0x3A bytes; Swift splits on extended-grapheme-cluster Characters. A combining mark (U+0301) after ':' merges ':'+mark into one non-':' Character in Swift (no split) but Go splits → `"workspace:́:/var/run/docker.sock"` gave proxy dst="́" (allowed) but socktainer target=/var/run/docker.sock (relay). FIX: reject any bind/mount path with a non-ASCII byte (`isASCII`, byte >= 0x80) wholesale — collapses the ENTIRE divergence class (combining marks, normalization, RTL, homoglyphs). Pure-ASCII is provably where Go byte-split == Swift grapheme-split (only ASCII cluster rule is CR+LF; ':' never merges).

**Final landed fix = forbiddenDest (basename docker.sock, case-insensitive, Clean/Base — a strict superset of socktainer's exact match) + splitBindSpec (drop-empty) + isASCII reject (Binds entries + Mounts Source/Target/Destination).** Verified SOUND by a 3rd refuter: fetched real socktainer source (DockerSocketRelay.swift, ContainerCreateRoute.swift, RESTConfig.swift) + fuzzed Go vs Swift 6.3.3 (20,033 cases, 0 mismatches); confirmed relay keys ONLY on Binds/Mounts(bind) destinations (no label/env/network/other vector), /start & /update can't inject mounts post-create, body forwarded byte-for-byte. 43 subtests pass.

**Bonus facts**: socktainer's Mount schema has NO `Destination` field (only `Target`, non-optional) — the proxy's `m.Destination` fallback is harmless over-caution. Go json (lenient, U+FFFD-replaces bad UTF-8, caught by isASCII) vs Swift JSONDecoder (rejects whole doc) is another divergence but directionally safe.

**ROOT-CAUSE lesson for Phase 2c**: reimplementing socktainer's parser to PREDICT its behavior is inherently fragile (2 differentials found). Investigate disabling socktainer's docker.sock-relay feature entirely as defense-in-depth behind the proxy screen. See [[apple-container-prototype-verdict]].
